name: Pipeliners - On-Page SEO Audit and Optimization Report 2026-07-24
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-07-24

# Summary
Rollup of the `seo-audit-2026-07-24` folder, centred on the 46-page "Pipeliners USA On-Page SEO Audit and Optimization Report" (PDF and HTML, completed Jul 24, 2026, prepared by TAG Marketing). Scope: full-site crawl, priority-page audit and live implementation.

# Key findings
- 121 URLs crawled, 20 priority pages audited and changed, 40 live edits deployed, 11 items needing approval.
- Condition: technically healthy but commercially invisible. 90 days to Jul 23: 57,630 impressions and 95 clicks (CTR about 0.16%, position 35.9). /glendale/ had 3,449 impressions and 0 clicks; /phoenix/ 2,360 and 0. Only the brand name produced meaningful clicks.
- Most important issue: Rank Math is deactivated, so every stored WordPress SEO title and meta is inert; OTTO serves the live tags. On 43 URLs OTTO had no title, so pages fell back to long raw titles (74 to 97 characters on /trenchless-sewer-repair/ and /whole-house-repipe/).
- Two pages had descriptions for the wrong service (for example the leak detection page described pipe lining). /free-sewer-inspection/ had three H1s and 155 words.
- Sections include cannibalization findings (six clusters, trenchless and CIPP first), technical on-page findings and QA results.

# Decisions and status
- Titles and descriptions for the 20 pages were rewritten and deployed through OTTO (the layer actually serving them); all 40 changes verified after a cache purge, with a regression check. No ranking improvement claimed. Re-measure Aug 21 and Sep 18 against unchanged city pages as a control.
- Next steps listed: decide the Rank Math question (recommendation: leave it off and standardize on OTTO), restore /is-pipelining-worth-it/ (404 while in the sitemap), fix the homepage link set, clear dead sitemaps from GSC, trigger an OTTO recrawl for four monsoon posts, expand /free-sewer-inspection/, fix 13 multiple-H1 pages, expand thin service pages, roll titles out to the remaining 31 city pages, resolve cannibalization, address out-of-market impressions.

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `Pipeliners-USA-On-Page-SEO-Audit-and-Optimization-Report.pdf` and `.html`: the report.
- `BACKUP_before-changes_2026-07-24.csv`: before values of the changed fields (backup).
- `_all_posts.csv`, `_sitemap_urls.txt`, `_crawl.json`, `_meta_raw.jsonl`, `optimizations.json`, Python and PHP scripts: working files, not summarized.
